config.baseline: plays in the 365 days before the show / shows with a setlist in that window (earlier shows only)
config.run_definition: same venue_id + tour_id, earlier show (app residency)
config.candidate_set: songs with >=1 play in the 3 years before the show (model's own universe)
config.method: walk-forward: retrain on all shows dated before each block, predict the block; run rule; isotonic fitted on the walk-forward chances of the calibration_days before each block
